title: Harper Oisiris Sixth Meeting

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Still skulking around like me then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Still skulking around like me then?

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: News? Yeah. I’m the proud new owner of four rejections, two interviews that ghosted me, and a courtesy call from a temp agency that wanted me to hand out Miso-paste samples on a street corner. At least I think it was an agency... He had a weird voice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: News? Yeah. I’m the proud new owner of four rejections, two interviews that ghosted me, and a courtesy call from a temp agency that wanted me to hand out Miso-paste samples on a street corner. At least I think it was an agency... He had a weird voice.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Yeah, right. Leave. We’re all happy little citizens of the Localized Unity Zone now. No one in, no one out. Mandatory solidarity. "Enforced by us, enjoyed by you!" What a joke.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, right. Leave. We’re all happy little citizens of the Localized Unity Zone now. No one in, no one out. Mandatory solidarity. "Enforced by us, enjoyed by you!" What a joke.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Classic CorpSec, they didn't even weld them properly. One of the clamps snapped last week. Some kid tried to slip through. You know what happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Classic CorpSec, they didn't even weld them properly. One of the clamps snapped last week. Some kid tried to slip through. You know what happened?

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: They let him get about ten meters past the threshold. Then the air blinked. like someone flicked off reality and he was just... gone. Not even a stain left behind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They let him get about ten meters past the threshold. Then the air blinked. like someone flicked off reality and he was just... gone. Not even a stain left behind.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Disturbing’s the baseline here, friend. If you’re not disturbed by that, you’re probably disturbed in a different way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Disturbing’s the baseline here, friend. If you’re not disturbed by that, you’re probably disturbed in a different way.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: One guy offered me a job threading biomesh into funeral suits. Said it was "close enough" to silicon weaving. Pays in city credits I can’t even spend outside the LUZ. I told him I’d think about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One guy offered me a job threading biomesh into funeral suits. Said it was "close enough" to silicon weaving. Pays in city credits I can’t even spend outside the LUZ. I told him I’d think about it.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Meh. Maybe I should take it. Seems fitting, right? At least then I’m helping someone leave The LUZ, even if it’s just a body.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Meh. Maybe I should take it. Seems fitting, right? At least then I’m helping someone leave The LUZ, even if it’s just a body.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: You sure? The way you're dragging your feet feels sort of skulky. Skulkular.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sure? The way you're dragging your feet feels sort of skulky. Skulkular.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: As my mother used to say, "Taste the paste, and it clings to your waist!" I'm not really sure what that means to be honest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As my mother used to say, "Taste the paste, and it clings to your waist!" I'm not really sure what that means to be honest.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Ok... Well they let him get about ten meters past the threshold. Then the air blinked. like someone flicked off reality and he was just... gone. Not even a stain left behind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok... Well they let him get about ten meters past the threshold. Then the air blinked. like someone flicked off reality and he was just... gone. Not even a stain left behind.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: And not a word from my brother. I can't stop thinking about him. What if he needs me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And not a word from my brother. I can't stop thinking about him. What if he needs me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure he'll find the funds.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure he'll find the funds.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sure he'll find the funds.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sure he'll find the funds.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I love him. I really do. But he doesn't always come through...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I love him. I really do. But he doesn't always come through...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't trust him with finding a sponsor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't trust him with finding a sponsor?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You don't trust him with finding a sponsor?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You don't trust him with finding a sponsor?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Any news?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any news?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're writing job applications? Are you mad? Shouldn't you be on the run?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're writing job applications? Are you mad? Shouldn't you be on the run?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're writing job applications? Are you mad? Shouldn't you be on the run?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're writing job applications? Are you mad? Shouldn't you be on the run?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I heard they even welded some of the transit gates shut.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I heard they even welded some of the transit gates shut.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I heard they even welded some of the transit gates shut.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I heard they even welded some of the transit gates shut.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That’s... disturbing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s... disturbing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess you're stuck here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess you're stuck here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And will you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And will you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can't say I'm much of a skulker.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't say I'm much of a skulker.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can't say I'm much of a skulker.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can't say I'm much of a skulker.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah I'd stay away from the Miso thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah I'd stay away from the Miso thing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah I'd stay away from the Miso thing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah I'd stay away from the Miso thing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Still thinking about leaving?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Still thinking about leaving?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't really want to know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't really want to know.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't really want to know.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't really want to know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's nothing you can do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's nothing you can do.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I know... I know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know... I know.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I hope he does this time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope he does this time.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I still can't believe Danny is trying to get my identity changed. Are you sure about that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I still can't believe Danny is trying to get my identity changed. Are you sure about that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah. You just have to trust him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. You just have to trust him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah. You just have to trust him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah. You just have to trust him.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I love him. I really do, but in a pinch, he doesn't always come through.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I love him. I really do, but in a pinch, he doesn't always come through.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I hope he does this time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope he does this time.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I just hope Danny finds the money for the identity change.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just hope Danny finds the money for the identity change.
